title: Camera
_about: Live video in an image widget while the page shows (camera.preview with widget, off on hide); a photo saved to the SD card (camera.capture save), or with no card (storage.info) held still in the image a few seconds from its base64 (src b64:); the camera's own AI (camera.detect); and a talk button ("talk": true, "photo": true) that asks Muse about what the camera sees: held, Muse listens, and its press takes a photo (camera.capture ask) that goes before the question. Photos and detections pause the video; it comes back by itself.
